## Function Cut Judges

One judge card per card with a code target; examples, Data blocks, callee contracts and preconditions in its instruction.

Behaviour: cutJudges({record, cuts, map, docs, defaultProfile, hasFile}) → Card[], in cut order. Per Cut Card: profile = its profile, else Detect Profile of its first target, else defaultProfile; code = codeTargets(profile, targets); none, or Functions none of which has an example (P34b) → no judge. Built id = "<customId>-judge"; the map card with that id overrides as for a code card. Default target: the profile's judgeTarget filled with {component: the base name of code[0]'s directory, name: code[0]'s base name without its extension}. dependsOn = [the card's id] then the override's dependsOn not yet present. test = testTarget(profile, targets) or targets[0]. Blocks: Judge Instruction(profile, {test, module: code[0], docs}); when the card has Functions: "The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. \"<first Function with examples> example 1\".", one block "Examples of Function <name>:\n" + Render Examples per Function with examples, dataBlocks(record, functions), one block "Callee <name>: <description>" + "\nBehaviour: <behavior>" when its behavior is not "" per callee (a calls target of the Functions that is none of them, a Function of the Component, distinct, step order), and when any line exists the block "Preconditions a test's setup depends on:" with lines "- <Component> · <Function> · <precondition>", distinct, from the card's Functions, then the callees, then every Function (record order) of each Component other than its own (by name) that a uses step names (by name or slug, distinct, step order); blocks joined by "\n\n", the override's instruction replacing the first. contextSlice = the override's, else docs, code[0] when absent, the profile's helpersModule when hasFile(it) and absent. budget judgeBudget(the examples of its Functions counted). Card = {customId, intent: override or "patch", targets, contextSlice, instruction, acceptance: override or Acceptance Script(profile, customId, targets), model: override or null, maxTokens: override or the budget's, reasoning {maxTokens: override or 2500}, variants: override or 1, dependsOn}.

node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; the environment is a parameter (P17). scaffold reads the template folders and writes the new project through node:fs (node:url only to find the package root from its own module file), spawns nothing, reads no clock and no environment (P18).

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.

## Function Cut Units

The Functions and map groups of one Component as card units, in record order.

Behaviour: cutUnits(component, groups). A group none of whose Functions belongs to the Component is skipped (it is another Component's); a group naming some of its Functions and some it does not have → {ok: false, error: "group '<g>' names unknown Function '<first unknown>' next to '<first known>' of Component '<c>': a group names the Functions of one Component"}. Then, per Function in record order: not in a group → {id: slugName(its name), name: its name, functions: [it], isGroup: false}; in a group not placed yet → {id: slugName(the group's name), name: the group's name, functions: the group's Functions in record order, isGroup: true}, placed where its first Function stands. → {ok: true, units}.

- reads: Contour Map
- produces: Unit
